title: Love the quit option
body: The quit option work surprisingly well for positive habits. I’m more motivated to complete the habit because I don’t have to open the app to log a missed day. This feature also helps with tracking a high volume of habits since I don’t have to manually check off every single one daily. Thank you for this update.
author: JP-nvm

title: Best interface for my needs
body: I love both the aesthetics and the functionality behind the app. It does things you naturally expect a habit tracker to do - which not many trackers actually accomplish
author: IngaKilch

title: Very good app
body: Really good app and widgets with good side features. Keeping it nice and simple and easy to use.
author: iOs raz

title: Loving this with a little thought
body:
Used this since start of 2025 and have been loving it! Thankfully have formed few habits thanks to the data visualization that gives a satisfying nudge regularly.
Wanting to make a suggested add-on feature, which is allowing people to log thoughts on dot when they completed a habit task, would be a great record keeping journal.
author: AlternativeNickname

title: Subscription locked
body: Looks like it could be a great app. But expecting a yearly fee just to have widget. Ridiculous
author: Markbaron

title: Works well!
body: It does what it says on the tin. Intuitive and allows for broad customisation. Would be nice if there were more colours or some kind of colour swatch picker thing. Only real gripe is the quite restrictive number of habits available without premium, but I guess you get what you pay for. It didn’t reduce the rating to 4 stars because I really respect the option for a one-time payment for premium instead of a subscription. I hope more apps adopt that.
author: PorgVader

title: Wish it had sync
body: If you could sync it across multiple devices I would totally be willing to buy the lifetime pass. Otherwise, great app - super simple and gorgeous (which is the main goal).
author: KellyBu

title: Best Habit tracker ever !
body: This app is the best habit tracker. I’ve used ant tried most of the other ones in the App Store to find they either have a less pleasant interface than HabitKit or they have to many un-necessary features that distract from the main objective of keeping habits consistent. Having all the heat maps on the one screen in year view really allowed me to not break the chain and keep up the habits daily. The design of the app is perfect. It’s professional and easy to use. I look forwards to more creations from this developer
author: Sargent sausages

title: Mr Habit
body: Very good
author: Mr Habit

title: Simple, visual and does the job.
body: I only have the free version, but that is all I need.
author: HowNowBeigeCow

title: Minimal and on point habit tracker
body:
I am liking this app already. Minimal design which makes it easy to log my habits.
Hoping for more few on-screen widget options.
author: basitfromIndia #indian

title: Great app
body:
Absolutely love your app. It’s simple and not complicated. 
I tried some other apps, but they added extra settings and features for no reason. Please keep it simple as it is right now.
author: Marzia.ar

title: No watch app
body: It’s very disappointing that this app isn’t Apple Watch compatible…
author: mitsukif

title: Such a great way to track habits!
body:
I’ve used a few different habit tracking apps, but HabitKit has been the one that I’ve stuck with the longest, and it looks great, too!

Tracking habits and keeping streaks going has changed my life for the better, and HabitKit has been a huge part of that process. Cannot recommend enough!
author: HeyFutureJesse

title: Almost Perfect
body: Well designed. Simple and effective. the only issue is that the mac app doesnt sync up or connect to the iphone app. they seem to work independently of each other. you can use the iphone widget on the mac but its not ideal
author: Dawilah

title: Simple and effective
body: Great app, very simple and effective. Lets you track your habits with ease.
author: L.M.C1

title: Powerful yet simple
body: Thanks for building such an awesome app, love the simplicity of everything compared to other bloated habit tracking solutions. This has been integral in keeping my routines on track 🎯
author: Lochie1991

title: Great but IAP?
body: Enjoy the app, however, I’m disappointed that I have to pay for simple functions like widgets — something that’s built into the operating system.
author: jrgibson1

title: Love this so much!
body: I use this app every day and it’s so satisfying to check something off! I love the ‘year in review’ part too. Definitely gonna use this forever!
author: 4MA3A

title: Really love the app
body:
I have been using the app for a week and love the fact UI and how easy it is to follow the UI and manage the habits. 

Love customisation of icons.. I wish there was a youtube icon as well.
author: SodhiAmy
